Hi Alina —

Thanks again for lining up the joint co-sell demo with Stratus and AWS. To make the live session smooth we want to run one integrated technical rehearsal (Redwood + Stratus + AWS SA) the week of Sep 21.

- Option A: Tue Sep 22, 09:30–10:30 PT (overlaps CET morning)
- Option B: Wed Sep 23, 07:00–08:00 PT (good for APAC attendees)
- Option C: Thu Sep 24, 16:00–17:00 PT (late EU-friendly slot)

Agenda (30–40 min technical run, 15–20 min handshake + fallback flows):
- Network/environment check (KV cache, VPC peering notes)
- End-to-end demo from Stratus SI perspective
- Live traffic routing failover (Redwood fallback to smaller model)
- Question / final roles for go-live day

I attached a short rehearsal-agenda.pdf and env-checklist.xlsx. If you can confirm which option works and add Ravi (AWS SA) to the thread, we will create back-to-back calendar blocks so we can do a quick dry-run and then a 30-minute handoff with stakeholders.

Note: Marissa will coordinate invite logistics and Vivek will validate the GPU/quantization paths for the demo. Karthik — can you own the end-to-end run-through with Stratus once time is confirmed?

Thanks —
Soojin
